rehearsal.ranFrom: a clean checkout of the release commit, with --ci-run naming the producer CI run

inspection.againstPrevious: Against the published 5.13.0: the same 86 files by count. dist/index.js, its map, dist/drawings.js and dist/index.d.ts change for drawingSelectionInk, the settings dialogs that open on their tab and the layout sync rows' hints on their info marks; the shared chunk takes a new hashed name; package.json and the feature manifest change the version; README.md and CHANGELOG.md document the changes. The export map, the stylesheet, LICENSE, NOTICE, THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md, the theme manifest and the REST description are unchanged.

ownerWaiver.question: Publish Quick Charts 5.14.0 (tarball sha256 bf605bfd97d6df97077d418cea8ad4f9a200113c48aa24d6fedd0247a1a5dc4f) once the app's first-host CI and the rehearsal pass, waiving manual screen-reader, device and advertised-browser acceptance (automated conformance only)? ownerWaiver.answerDetail: Chosen from the options offered with that question. Manual accessibility and advertised browser and device acceptance were not performed; the browser suites passed in Chromium, Firefox and WebKit.
